release_notes:
Custom-field UX: API-labeled pickers, auto-attach sync option, PHP 8 order fixes, popup redesign

- Custom-field pickers (IMEI/server/file, General + Fields tabs) now label each field with its supplier API and list only that service's API fields (plus manual and already-selected), so per-API duplicates like "SN" are unambiguous. Custom Fields admin list gains an "API / Supplier" column.
- New DHRU-only sync toggle "Sync Custom Field Attachments" (IMEI + Server sync tabs). Re-syncs each service's attached fields to exactly match the supplier's current requirements (detach dropped, attach new, set IMEI services to Custom Fields Only); scoped per supplier API so manual fields are preserved; idempotent; default off. "Synchronize Custom Fields" is now shown only for DHRU Fusion APIs.
- Fix PHP 8 false "Repeated IMEI(s) OR Invalid Data" on Custom-field (type 3) IMEI orders: length checks now guard with is_numeric() && > 0 so an empty MaxLength is skipped.
- Fix escaped apostrophe in order result messages (stripslashes the msge redirect value) and replace removed FILTER_SANITIZE_STRING (PHP 8.1) in addtocart.php.
- The Custom primary IMEI field is marked required; redesign the price-margins popup to match the admin theme.
